original.statement: Istio now allows extra white spaces between namespaces in the networking.istio.io/exportTo annotation.

decision.reason: [ev-1252a2a51c0c] says only that users may now put extra white space between namespaces in the networking.istio.io/exportTo annotation. That is a change in how an existing annotation is parsed, not a new setting. A protocol-behavior subject named "exportto-annotation-whitespace" uses the evidence's own key words and stays unambiguous, and behavior-changed fits a parsing relaxation applied to the same configuration. The validators were inconclusive, so this rests only on the release-note text, and choosing the family is a judgment call.
